text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the autumn Tenno Sho, and Gold Ship unveils her secret weapon in preparation for this massive stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The weapon? A pile of prickly sea urchin-stuffed chestnuts, spiky shells and all! With these, all of Gold Ship's rivals will eat her dust! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I confiscate them all, of course, to ensure a fair race against Tosen Jordan.
